summary: Store plan: everything the Play Console store listing and policy forms need, as files in docs/store/play (listing text, Data safety, Content rating and App access answers, the 512 px icon, the feature graphic and six 1080x1920 screenshots). The screenshots come from a Robolectric test that renders the real Compose screens in demo mode and is skipped unless SB_STORE_SHOTS_DIR is set. No app behaviour changes.

desktop.reason: The listing is for the Android app on Google Play; the desktop app ships through GitHub releases and gains nothing here.

reactNativeIos.reason: This batch covers Google Play only. The App Store listing for the Expo app is a separate step of the store plan.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No protocol, API or shared code change; the screenshots read the existing demo fixture.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data or schema change; the new file is a unit test and the rest are docs and images.

automated: Gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*StoreScreenshotsTest' with SB_STORE_SHOTS_DIR set rendered the six screenshots; without it the test is skipped.
Image sizes and formats checked with Pillow: icon 512x512 RGBA, feature graphic 1024x500 RGB, screenshots 1080x1920.
npm run typecheck and npm test pass.
notExercised: Nothing was uploaded to Play Console; a browser session uploads these files.
Screenshots are Robolectric renders, not captures from a phone or an emulator.
